cards.name: The Gravedigger's Hands

rev.say: Reversed, the hands dig their own grave. They are very good at it.

cards.say: You have buried more than you remember. Your hands have not forgotten.

cards.name: The Moth

rev.say: The moth, upside down: it has already burned. It moves quicker for it.

cards.say: Drawn to every light that burns you. You will find pretty things in the ash.

cards.name: The Lamb

rev.say: The lamb reversed is the knife. Softness was never going to last.

cards.say: Soft. Warm. It will not last, but it will bleed a long while.

cards.name: The Crow

rev.say: The crow turned over picks at better things than coin.

cards.say: You will pick at what the others leave behind. So do I.

cards.name: The Weeping Saint

rev.say: The saint reversed stops weeping and starts to endure.

cards.say: She wept for all of you. None of you wept for her.

cards.name: The Scholar's Eye

rev.say: The eye turned inward learns faster, and sees less.

cards.say: You will read the world closely. The world does not like being read.

cards.name: The Hanged Twin

rev.say: Reversed, it is the hanged one you become. Heavier. Harder to kill.

cards.say: One of you hangs. The other runs. You know which one you are.

cards.name: The Rat King

rev.say: The rat king reversed hoards instead of eats.

cards.say: Many mouths, one hunger. You will eat well at every grave.

cards.name: The Wick

rev.say: The wick upside down burns slow. You will last. You will be slow about it.

cards.say: You burn quickly. Everyone who burns quickly thinks it is a gift.

cards.name: The Pilgrim

rev.say: The pilgrim reversed runs from the road instead of walking it.

cards.say: A long road, and nothing at the end of it. You will walk it anyway.

cards.name: The Mourner

rev.say: Grief reversed is rage. It will feed your spells and leave you open.

cards.say: Grief has made you hard to wound. It has made you hard to love, too.

cards.name: The Ossuary Key

rev.say: The key turned opens the other doors, the ones with treasure behind them.

cards.say: It opens every door in the house of bones. Only one of them lets you out.

cards.name: The Beggar's Cup

rev.say: The cup reversed spills gold. You will be rich and learn nothing.

cards.say: Empty, always empty. You will fill it with the lives of others.

cards.name: The Drowned Bell

rev.say: The bell reversed rings upward, out of the water. You will hurry toward the surface all your life.

cards.say: It still rings under the fen. Everyone who hears it goes a little slower, a little safer.

cards.name: The First Coin

rev.say: The coin kept, never spent. It rings when you strike. Things flinch from it.

cards.say: The first thing you ever sold. It fit in your palm. You have been finding smaller things to sell ever since.

cards.name: The Kiln

rev.say: The kiln gone cold. Whatever was inside hardened slowly. It will not crack.

cards.say: What goes in soft comes out hard, or does not come out.

cards.name: The Unravelling Loom

rev.say: The loom turned over weaves tighter. Slower, but it holds together under blows.

cards.say: Someone is weaving you and someone is pulling the thread out, and they are working at the same speed.

bones.say: A crown. Yes. The god wore one too, before it was carved up for meat.
An open door. Everything is an open door, to those who do not look at what waits inside.

bones.see: A mouth, and nothing behind it
bones.say: A hungry mouth. Ha. So you do know yourself, a little.
A child. Whose, I wonder? Not yours. Nothing of you will be left to have children.
Down. Always down. Every road in this world goes down in the end.

bones.see: A tower that is also a grave
bones.say: The Tower. Walls to keep the dead in, or the living out. It never matters which.
They leave before the end. Clever birds. Cleverer than you.
It weeps because it has seen your ending. Do not ask me to describe it.

bones.see: A wheel with one spoke missing
bones.say: The Wheel, and a gap in it. Something is going to fall through that gap. Let us hope it is not you.
A rope. For climbing, or for the other thing. You will need your strength either way.

bones.see: A moon split by a crack
bones.say: The cracked moon. Light spills out of it on the nights things are found.

bones.see: A spine, curled like a sleeper
bones.say: A spine curled up asleep. It will wake in you when you are struck. It will not let you fall.

stars.name: Oss-Vharoth
stars.blurb: Bone: skeletons, the Colossus, bone spells, melee
stars.say: Oss-Vharoth. The Standing Dead, the skeleton that would not lie down when the god fell. It held your cradle the way a grave holds a coffin. You will stand. You will not bend. You will break.

stars.name: Nol-Shogthuth
stars.blurb: Blood: a brood of spawn, bleeding, mutations; every spell costs life
stars.say: Nol-Shogthuth, the flesh that keeps growing with no mind to stop it. The Wheel turns in her and she drinks what spills. She was ascendant, and she was thirsty. You will live long enough to regret it.

stars.name: Yh'Anuul
stars.blurb: Breath: wisps, the iron golem, spirit magic
stars.say: Yh'Anuul, the god's last exhale, still leaving the body and never done leaving. It leaned close to your cradle and listened. Little moth. Little moth.

stars.name: The Myriad
stars.blurb: The purifiers: miasma drawn out of the world and turned on its makers, claws, traps, killing blows
stars.say: The Myriad. Not one god: every stone and river and rotting thing in this corpse-world has a small spirit of its own, and they are choking on the filth. Your people bow to all of them. You will draw the rot out of the world, hold it in yourself, and give it back to what made it.

stars.name: Ur-Nihl
stars.blurb: Empty Laughter: radiance by day, absence by night, stone always
stars.say: Ur-Nihl. ... No. I will not look into the bowl for that one. See: the blood has gone still. Smooth as black glass. It is not a god that looked down on you. It is the hole the gods are lying in, and it was smiling.

sacrifices.say: Your name, then. No one will speak it over your grave. There will be no one to speak.
Your shadow. Light as smoke without it. Thin as smoke, too.
The left eye. It saw too much kindness anyway. Now you will see only what you strike.
Cold, then. The cold keeps. The cold keeps everything.
Her face. Already gone. You will wonder, some nights, whose voice that was.
No more sleep. No more dreams. You will not miss the dreams. Trust me.
Your voice. You will scream silently now, like the rest of us.
Luck. Ha! You never had much. I will take what there is.

sacrifices.txt: +1 life after each kill · -1% gold found
sacrifices.say: Hunger. Strange gift to give. The dead will feed you instead.
Taste. You will eat ash and marrow and not mind it. Good. That is most of what there is.
The song. I will hum it sometimes. You will not recognise it.
You will not fear falling. You will fall a great deal, and you will get up faster for it.

tower.name: The Gravekeeper
tower.txt: +1 to Ossuary skills · +4 armor · -1% faster movement
tower.say: The Gravekeeper, lantern low, counting his dead. He will lend you the ones he cannot fit in the ground.

tower.name: The Marrow-Eater
tower.say: The Marrow-Eater cracks the bones to suck out what is inside. Hungry god. Hungry child.

tower.name: The Ossuary Wall
tower.txt: +1 to Carapace skills · +2 Constitution · -1% faster cast rate
tower.say: The Wall. Bone on bone on bone. Behind it you will be safe. Nothing behind it is ever safe.

wheel.name: The Brood-Bride
wheel.txt: +1 to Brood skills · +1% life · -1% skill damage
wheel.say: The Brood-Bride. Every tumour is a child to her. You will make a very good mother.

wheel.name: The Open Vein
wheel.txt: +1 to Blood skills · +1% skill damage · -1% life
wheel.say: The Open Vein. She never closed. She never will. Neither will you.

wheel.name: The Butcher
wheel.txt: +1 to Flesh skills · +2 Constitution · -1% magic resist
wheel.say: The Butcher, apron stiff with it. She taught the golem how to stand. She will teach you how to carve.

lantern.name: The Soul-Smith
lantern.txt: +1 to Iron skills · +4 armor · -1% faster cast rate
lantern.say: The Soul-Smith hammers breath into iron. The iron screams, and then it obeys. Everything obeys, in the end.

lantern.name: The Lantern-Bearer
lantern.txt: +1 to Anima skills · +1% faster wisp regrowth · -3 armor
lantern.say: The Lantern-Bearer. The wisps come to her like moths. They will come to you. Pray they are only moths.

lantern.name: The Speaker
lantern.txt: +1 to Logos skills · +1% faster cast rate · -1% life
lantern.say: The Speaker. Her words unmade a city. Yours will unmake smaller things. Begin with yourself.

hollow.name: The Purifier
hollow.txt: +1 to Miasma skills · +1% magic resist · -1% life
hollow.say: The Purifier. She draws the defilement out of the dead and binds it in paper. Breathe in what the world cannot bear, little assassin.

hollow.name: The Keeper at the Gate
hollow.txt: +1 to Distortion skills · +1% faster movement · -3 armor
hollow.say: The Keeper at the Gate, who guards the spirit road. It is never where you look. Neither will you be.

hollow.name: The Bell-Rope
hollow.txt: +1 to Death skills · +1 life after each kill · -1% magic resist
hollow.say: The Bell-Rope, pulled to wake the spirits before a killing. One pull for every ending. It will be pulled once for you.

silence.name: The Laughing Face
silence.txt: +1 to Radiance skills · +1% skill damage · -1% magic resist
silence.say: The Laughing Face. It laughs at the sun for thinking it could clean anything. Laugh with it, and burn.

silence.name: The Empty Bowl
silence.txt: +1 to Absence skills · +1 life after each kill · -1% life
silence.say: The Empty Bowl. Everything poured into it is gone. Beg with it, little monk. The world will fill it for you.

silence.name: The Unmoved
silence.txt: +1 to Destroyer skills · +2 Constitution · -1% faster movement
silence.say: The Unmoved. A mountain does not hate the valley. It simply falls on it.

fears.name: The dark
fears.say: The dark. Good. It is the one thing down there that will never lie to you.

fears.name: Burning
fears.say: Fire. Everything you love will burn, so you have that to look forward to.

fears.name: Drowning
fears.say: Drowning. You will hold your breath a long time. Longer than the others. Not long enough.

fears.name: Being surrounded
fears.say: So many hands. You will learn to wear something thick. It will not be enough.

fears.name: Being forgotten
fears.say: Forgotten. Then go and do something worth remembering. Quickly.

fears.name: The dogs
fears.say: The dogs. You can hear them already, can you not? Run.

fears.name: Your own face
fears.say: Your own face. Wise. I have seen it. I would not look either.

fears.name: Starving
fears.say: Hunger. The dead are full of meat. You will learn not to mind.

fears.name: Bells
fears.say: Bells. Yes. There is one in the ash that walks. You will know it by its ringing. Run sideways.

fears.name: Hands in the dark
fears.say: Hands. They run on their fingers out there. Keep your back to a wall and they cannot come around you.

fears.name: Silence
fears.say: Silence. Then you fear the right thing. The only thing. Most never learn to.

seeks.name: Vengeance
seeks.say: Vengeance. That door is heavy, and it only opens one way.

seeks.name: Knowledge
seeks.say: Knowledge. There is a library beneath the Crypt. Its books read you back.

seeks.name: Wealth
seeks.say: Gold. Of course. The dead do not need it, and they will not stop you. Mostly.

seeks.name: Absolution
seeks.say: Absolution. From whom? Every god you could ask is dead or hungry.

seeks.name: Oblivion
seeks.say: Oblivion. That door is always open. You need not hurry.

seeks.name: Power
seeks.say: Power. They all say power. They all looked like you when they said it.

seeks.name: A way home
seeks.say: A way home. There is no home. There is a road, and it is long, and it goes down.

seeks.name: The dead god
seeks.say: The dead god itself. Its heart is down there somewhere, under all of us. You would not be the first to go looking. You would not be the last to be eaten.

seeks.name: A god who answers
seeks.say: A god who answers. Oh, they answer. That is the whole trouble with them.

seeks.name: Your kin
seeks.say: Your kin. The Tithed scatter like seed. Some of them took root in very strange places.

seeks.name: The end of all of it
seeks.say: The end. You would hand the world to the Void? Then you had better be strong enough to carry it there.

roads.name: The Pilgrim Road
roads.say: The pilgrim road. Worn hollow by knees. Everyone on it was walking to a god who had already died.

roads.name: The Black River
roads.say: The river. It runs under the barrows and comes up cold. You still smell of it.

roads.name: The Ash Road
roads.say: The ash road. Something burned at both ends of it. You walked through the middle.

roads.name: The Ossuary Stair
roads.say: The stair of bones. Every step was someone. You counted them, at first.

roads.name: The Red Ditch
roads.txt: +1 life after each kill · -1% magic resist
roads.say: The red ditch. It was a road once. Then the war came, and then the war stayed.

roads.name: The Lampless Way
roads.say: No lamps on that way. You found it by touch. Your hands remember things your eyes never saw.

roads.name: The Bell Road
roads.say: The bell road. They ring for the dead up there, day and night. You learned to speak between the strokes.

roads.name: No Road at All
roads.say: No road. You simply were here, one evening, by my fire. That happens more than you would think. It is never good.

prophecies: You will die in the dark, and it will not be the last time.
A crown of bone is waiting for a head. It is not particular about whose.
Something below the Crypt has learned your name. Try not to answer it.
The lanterns will keep calling you back. Ask yourself why they want you so badly.
Three faces will want you. None of them will want you whole.

q: When you woke in the ash, something was in your hand.

a.say: A stone. You held on to the world before you knew what it was. It will hold on to you.
Nothing. Empty hands run faster. They catch less, too.
Another hand. Cold? It was cold. You have been holding the dead ever since.
a.txt: +1 life after each kill · -1% gold found

q: There is a voice in the Drowned Fen that speaks to travellers.
When you passed, what did it say?

a.say: Your name. So it knows you. Learn quickly, before it learns the rest.
Nothing you understood. A mercy. Understanding is how it gets in.
My name? ...Then it is looking for me through you. Find it pretty things, little messenger.

q: Everyone here was buried once. The god made sure of that.

a.say: Your mother. She buried you gently. You will be hard to kill because of it.
A stranger, who took your boots for the trouble. You will learn to take boots too.

a.ans: No one. I dug myself out
a.say: You dug yourself out. Your hands remember the dirt. Your spirit remembers less.

q: Suppose you find it. The dead god. Whatever is left of its heart.

a.say: Bury a world. It would take a very long time. You have that, perhaps.
Eat it! Ha. Many have tried. The god is patient with its eaters. It becomes them.
a.txt: +1 life after each kill · -1% magic resist

a.say: Wake it. Then the Void comes for you first. Remember I warned you.

q: The lanterns call you back each time you fall.
Why do you think they want you?

a.say: Kind. Yes. Hold on to that one. Hold on hard.
Useful. A tool that knows it is a tool. That is almost a person.
Hungry. Now you are thinking like one of us.

bones: Your hands are shaking. Good. Still hands lie.
The bones were a child's once. Everything here was something else once.
fear: You flinched. Where the Tithed walk, flinching keeps you alive. Fools call it cowardice.
I will not laugh at what you fear. I fear things too. Worse things.
seek: Some go down for gold, some for gods. The god does not care why. It eats both.
You want something. It is written all over you, in a hand I do not like.
sac: We are nearly done. This is the part that hurts.
Do not look away from the knife. It is rude.

nA.name: The Kept Wall
nA.lore: The ribs were a vault before they were a crypt.

nB.name: Marrow Patience
nB.lore: The duelists in the dark still go through their forms. They are in no hurry.

nA.name: The Red Tithe
nA.lore: The Maiden takes her tenth. She leaves you the rest, warm.

nB.name: Open Veins
nB.lore: A wound that never scabbed is a well that never dries.

nA.name: The Held Breath
nA.lore: She did not breathe out. She is still looking for someone who will.

nB.name: Salt on the Threshold
nB.lore: The guardian stone at the torii faces the wrong way. She turns it back each time she passes.

nA.name: Noon and Midnight
nA.lore: The glass remembers his laugh by day. By night it remembers what he laughed at.

nA.name: The Lantern's Patience
nA.lore: A little longer. A little longer. Every wick says this.

nB.name: Quicksilver Tongue
nB.lore: The prayer is shorter if you leave out the parts that beg.

n.name: Blood Set in Bone
n.lore: Blood from the kill hardens as it cools. Some of it keeps the shape.

n.name: Rot and Rust
n.lore: The fen smells of iron and old incense: the incense from the chapels, the iron from what was left.

n.name: The Wrong-Side Stone
n.lore: Each time it is turned back, it turns again.

n.name: Lantern in the Fist
n.lore: His black-flame lantern reads brighter the deeper he walks.

n.name: Bone Under Candle
n.lore: The votive candles in the ribs never blow out. The ribs keep the wind off them.

notables.lore: The skull is the last bone to lie down. His never will.

notables.name: The Kept Wall
notables.lore: The ribs were a vault before they were a crypt.

notables.name: The Elbow That Does Not Bend
notables.lore: A joint is a place where bone agrees to give. His agree to nothing.

notables.name: Marrow Patience
notables.lore: The duelists in the dark still go through their forms. They are in no hurry.

notables.name: The Kneeling Refused
notables.lore: Old Upright never knelt. Neither will you.

notables.name: Heavy Tread
notables.lore: The dust keeps his footprints longer than it should.

notables.name: The Holy Bone
notables.lore: Os sacrum. The oldest priests buried it last, because it was the last to be given back.

notables.name: The Red Tithe
notables.lore: The Maiden takes her tenth. She leaves you the rest, warm.

notables.name: Open Veins
notables.lore: A wound that never scabbed is a well that never dries.

notables.name: The Wrist Offered
notables.lore: The brotherhoods cut here first. It is the easiest place to ask.

notables.name: Blood to the Temple
notables.lore: Every thought is carried on something red.

notables.name: The Fork of the River
notables.lore: Where the great vessel parts, the fen-folk say, a child is always listening.

notables.name: The Kneeling Pulse
notables.lore: Kneel, and you can hear it behind the knee.

notables.name: Thin Blood
notables.lore: It runs faster. It runs out faster.

animancer.sub: the nerves and threads of the Hollow Mystic

notables.name: The Loom Behind the Eyes
notables.lore: The Weaver does not see. It is seen through.

notables.name: The Lantern's Patience
notables.lore: A little longer. A little longer. Every wick says this.

notables.name: The Unraveller
notables.lore: Every thread is cut in the end. Some of them are cut by you.

notables.name: Quicksilver Tongue
notables.lore: The prayer is shorter if you leave out the parts that beg.

notables.name: The Moths Return
notables.lore: They always come back to the hand that let them go.

notables.name: The Thread in the Spine
notables.lore: Pull it, and the whole body answers.

notables.name: The Long Nerve
notables.lore: Pain takes the longest road in the body. So does news.

miasmancer.title: The Well-Shrine
miasmancer.sub: the breath of the Shrine Keeper

notables.name: The Last Breath
notables.lore: The god died breathing out, and never finished. She finishes it for him, a little at a time.

notables.name: The Held Breath
notables.lore: She did not breathe out. She is still looking for someone who will.

notables.name: The Fan Unfolded
notables.lore: The breath goes where the fan tells it to.

notables.name: Salt on the Threshold
notables.lore: The guardian stone at the torii faces the wrong way. She turns it back each time she passes.

notables.name: Grandmother Wind
notables.lore: She carries the small gods home on her back.

notables.name: The Undertow
notables.lore: What is breathed in must go somewhere. It goes down.

notables.name: The Mouth of the Well
notables.lore: The Well-Shrine was dug where a drowned child first breathed out.

monk.title: The Black-Flame Road
monk.sub: the channels of the Empty Hand

notables.name: The Hundred Meetings
notables.lore: The glass remembers his laugh by day. By night it remembers what he laughed at.

notables.name: The Sea of Breath
notables.lore: The middle dantian. Fill it, and nothing knocks you over.

notables.name: Lantern in the Fist
notables.lore: His black-flame lantern reads brighter the deeper he walks.

notables.name: The Empty Laugh
notables.lore: Ha. Once. It is enough.

notables.name: The Bubbling Spring
notables.lore: The first point of the kidney channel is in the sole. He walks barefoot so it can drink.

notables.name: The Barefoot Gate
notables.lore: Stone is honest to a bare foot.

notables.name: Three Leagues More
notables.lore: The point below the knee that gives a tired walker three leagues more.

notables.lore: Where the great vessel parts, the fen-folk say, a child is always listening.

notables.name: The Kneeling Pulse
notables.lore: Kneel, and you can hear it behind the knee.

notables.name: Thin Blood
notables.lore: It runs faster. It runs out faster.

w_hem_3.name: Blood to the Temple
w_hem_3.lore: Every thought is carried on something red.

w_hem_13.name: The Red Tithe
w_hem_13.lore: The Maiden takes her tenth. She leaves you the rest, warm.

w_hem_28.name: Open Veins
w_hem_28.lore: A wound that never scabbed is a well that never dries.

w_hem_32.name: The Wrist Offered
w_hem_32.lore: The brotherhoods cut here first. It is the easiest place to ask.

w_hem_50.name: The Fork of the River
w_hem_50.lore: Where the great vessel parts, the fen-folk say, a child is always listening.

w_hem_57.name: The Kneeling Pulse
w_hem_57.lore: Kneel, and you can hear it behind the knee.

w_hem_64.name: Thin Blood
w_hem_64.lore: It runs faster. It runs out faster.

plate.title: The Well-Shrine
plate.sub: the breath of the Shrine Keeper

notables.name: The Last Breath
notables.lore: The god died breathing out, and never finished. She finishes it for him, a little at a time.

notables.name: The Held Breath
notables.lore: She did not breathe out. She is still looking for someone who will.

notables.name: The Fan Unfolded
notables.lore: The breath goes where the fan tells it to.

notables.name: Salt on the Threshold
notables.lore: The guardian stone at the torii faces the wrong way. She turns it back each time she passes.

notables.name: Grandmother Wind
notables.lore: She carries the small gods home on her back.

notables.name: The Undertow
notables.lore: What is breathed in must go somewhere. It goes down.

notables.name: The Mouth of the Well
notables.lore: The Well-Shrine was dug where a drowned child first breathed out.

w_shr_1.name: The Mouth of the Well
w_shr_1.lore: The Well-Shrine was dug where a drowned child first breathed out.

w_shr_9.name: The Last Breath

w_shr_53.name: The Fan Unfolded
w_shr_53.lore: The breath goes where the fan tells it to.

w_shr_63.name: The Held Breath

w_shr_72.name: Grandmother Wind

w_shr_95.name: The Undertow
w_shr_95.lore: What is breathed in must go somewhere. It goes down.

plate.title: The Black-Flame Road
plate.sub: the channels of the Empty Hand

notables.name: The Hundred Meetings
notables.lore: The glass remembers his laugh by day. By night it remembers what he laughed at.

notables.name: The Sea of Breath
notables.lore: The middle dantian. Fill it, and nothing knocks you over.

notables.name: Lantern in the Fist
notables.lore: His black-flame lantern reads brighter the deeper he walks.

notables.name: The Empty Laugh
notables.lore: Ha. Once. It is enough.

notables.name: The Bubbling Spring
notables.lore: The first point of the kidney channel is in the sole. He walks barefoot so it can drink.

notables.name: The Barefoot Gate
notables.lore: Stone is honest to a bare foot.

notables.name: Three Leagues More
notables.lore: The point below the knee that gives a tired walker three leagues more.

w_kus_3.name: The Sea of Breath
w_kus_3.lore: The middle dantian. Fill it, and nothing knocks you over.

w_kus_11.name: The Hundred Meetings
w_kus_11.lore: The glass remembers his laugh by day. By night it remembers what he laughed at.

w_kus_30.name: Lantern in the Fist
w_kus_30.lore: His black-flame lantern reads brighter the deeper he walks.

w_kus_72.name: Three Leagues More
w_kus_72.lore: The point below the knee that gives a tired walker three leagues more.

w_kus_102.name: The Bubbling Spring
w_kus_102.lore: The first point of the kidney channel is in the sole. He walks barefoot so it can drink.

w_kus_114.name: The Barefoot Gate
w_kus_114.lore: Stone is honest to a bare foot.

body_board.peg_note: each order has its own body plate; by_class.<cls>.nodes is that plate's graph (root, pegs, notables, card sockets) with x,y in board units, fx the stat deltas, links the roads; card_positions are the Major/Minor cards laid on that plate

o_pyredead.name: The Pyre-Dead
o_pyredead.up: Your skeletons are truly on fire: they run faster, hunt anything in sight, strike faster and burn everything next to them, but the fire eats them fast (6% of their life a second) and they crumble; their bone returns to your aura.
o_pyredead.rev: Skeletons don't burn while they stand. When they fall they burst into fire and leave the ground burning.

o_bowyer.name: The Bowyer
o_bowyer.up: Squads can take the Bow loadout: archers shoot from range.
o_bowyer.rev: Squads can take the Bow loadout, and archers become harpooners: their shots hook enemies and drag them toward your melee skeletons.

o_chanter.name: The Grave-Chanter
o_chanter.up: Squads can take the Mage loadout: skeleton mages cast a small copy of the last Marrow spell you cast.
o_chanter.rev: Squads can take the Mage loadout, but mages don't fight. They chant the bone out of the earth: each one near you adds 50% to your aura's pull.

o_oath.name: The Oathbound
o_oath.up: Skeletons hold a line: they never stray more than 4 yd from you and take 30% less damage.
o_oath.rev: Skeletons ignore their orders and hunt anything within 12 yd. Each kill makes them all faster for 5 s (up to 5 times).

o_shove.name: Shoving Dead
o_shove.up: Skeleton melee hits shove enemies back a step.

o_rise.name: Grave Rise
o_rise.up: A skeleton clawing out of the ground cuts everything around it.

o_return.name: Bone Returns
o_return.up: A fallen skeleton sends 2 shards straight back to your aura.

o_stride.name: Colossal Stride
o_stride.up: The Colossus shoves enemies aside as it walks, staggering them.

o_herald.name: Heralds of Bone
o_herald.up: While you direct the Colossus, your skeletons move 25% faster.

o_rattle.name: The Rattle
o_rattle.up: A skeleton rising from the ground taunts enemies within 3 yd for 2 s.

o_tower.name: The Tower
o_tower.up: Bone Spear splits into 3 splinters on the first enemy it hits.
o_tower.rev: Melee: Bone Spear becomes a thrust from your hand that hits everything in a 3 yd line at once, for half the cost.

o_cage.name: The Cage-Warden
o_cage.up: Rib Cage springs a cage around each of up to 3 enemies near the cursor.
o_cage.rev: Rib Cage closes around you instead: while it lasts you take 35% less damage and anything that hits you is thrown back and cut.

o_grasp.name: The Grasping Earth
o_grasp.up: Bone Arms grab: the first enemy each arm catches is held in place for 1.5 s.
o_grasp.rev: Melee: for as long as the arms would last, bone arms erupt around your feet as you walk instead of in a line.

o_rime.name: Rime
o_rime.up: Bone Spikes and Shard Storm chill. Frozen enemies that die shatter into shards for your aura.
o_rime.rev: Your shard aura chills anything that strikes you in melee, but your spells don't chill.

m_caltrop.name: Caltrops
m_caltrop.up: Bone Spear leaves a caltrop where it stops. It cuts and slows for 3 s.

m_return.name: Boomerang Bone
m_return.up: Bone Spear flies back to you when its flight ends, cutting again on the way.

m_hooks.name: Rib Hooks
m_hooks.up: Rib Cage drags the enemies inside it toward its center.

m_echo.name: Spike Echo
m_echo.up: Bone Spikes erupt a second time 0.6 s later at half damage.

m_scatter.name: Scatter
m_scatter.up: Shard Storm shards that fall to the ground can be pulled back into your aura.

m_tread.name: Marrow Tread
m_tread.up: Bone Arms knock enemies off their feet as they rise.

o_reliq.name: The Reliquary
o_reliq.up: While you wear the Bone Host, missiles that strike you are thrown back as bone.
o_reliq.rev: Ranged: wearing the Bone Host roots you in place as a bone turret. It fires the carapace at the nearest enemy as shards.

o_maelstrom.name: The Maelstrom
o_maelstrom.up: The shard aura spins wide and slow, cutting everything within 3 yd.
o_maelstrom.rev: Ranged: every attack you make also flings a shard from your aura at the target, but the aura no longer turns blows aside.

c_trail.name: Shard Trail
c_trail.up: Dodge rolls leave a trail of shards that cut enemies crossing them.

c_crash.name: Crash
c_crash.up: Grinding Charge ends in a shockwave.

c_spines.name: Carapace Spines
c_spines.up: When your Bone Host carapace cracks, its shards burst outward and cut.

c_grind.name: Grinding Pull
c_grind.up: Shards your aura pulls through enemies slow them.

c_throw.name: Thrown Shard
c_throw.up: Every fourth weapon hit throws a shard in a straight line.

o_marrowkin.name: The Marrow-Kin
o_marrowkin.up: Blood from your kills hardens into bone: a third of them burst into spikes.

o_revenant.name: The Revenant
o_revenant.up: A fallen skeleton rises as a spirit for 5 s and keeps fighting.

h_graft.name: The Graft-Father
h_graft.up: Three spawnlings that touch fuse into a chimera: bigger, slower, with a bigger bite and burst.
h_graft.rev: Up to 4 spawnlings ride on your body instead of walking. Your weapon hits get their bites, and Rabid Charge flings them off at the enemy.

h_clutch.name: The Clutch
h_clutch.up: Tumors that land without hitting anything lie in wait and hatch into a clutch when an enemy walks close. Every tumor is a trap.
h_clutch.rev: Your tumors are fat and slow: each bursts harder and wider, into three spawnlings.

h_giant.name: The Hollow Giant
h_giant.up: When the Flesh Golem drops below half life it tears off a Flesh Spawn, a half-size golem that fights for 20 s.
h_giant.rev: Melee: you wear the golem. You are huge, slow and hit hard, it soaks most blows, and your brood hatches from your body.

h_pyre.name: Pyre
h_pyre.up: Spawnlings burn: their bites set enemies on fire, and they die in a burst of flame.

b_twin.name: Twin Birth
b_twin.up: Each corpse you hatch has a 35% chance to give one more spawnling.

b_wall.name: Tumor Wall
b_wall.up: Tumors lying on the ground stop enemy missiles.

b_throes.name: Death Throes
b_throes.up: A spawnling that dies bites everything next to it.

b_glut.name: Glut
b_glut.up: The Flesh Golem eats twice as fast and heals 10% more from each meal.

b_lurch.name: Quivering Oozes
b_lurch.up: Blood Oozes move 40% faster and spit twice as often.

h_tide.name: The Crimson Tide
h_tide.up: Blood Vomit gouts often split into three after the first body they soak through.
h_tide.rev: Melee: a sword of blood sweeps an arc in front of you and leaves a pool.

h_leech.name: The Leech
h_leech.up: Root Veins drain 2% of your life for every enemy they bite.
h_leech.rev: Ranged: the veins shoot out as a hooked tendril up to 7 yd and drag the first enemy to you.

h_blight.name: The Blood-Queen
h_blight.up: Bleeding spreads: every 2 s a bleeding enemy passes its bleed to its nearest neighbor.
h_blight.rev: Bleeding doesn't tick. It gathers, and bursts all at once for 150% when it ends.

h_rime.name: Rime
h_rime.up: Blood freezes: bleeding enemies are chilled, and a long bleed freezes them solid.
h_rime.rev: Blood pools freeze into ice. Enemies that step on them slip and can't act for 1 s.

l_drag.name: Undertow
l_drag.up: Hemorrhage drags the enemies around its target in toward it.

l_sympathy.name: Sympathetic Burst
l_sympathy.up: Corpse Burst makes everything it hits bleed.

l_clot.name: Clotting
l_clot.up: Blood Vomit splashes root what they hit for 0.6 s.

l_lash.name: Deep Lash
l_lash.up: Root Veins' bleeding lasts twice as long.

l_wind.name: Scent of Blood
l_wind.up: Blood Frenzy reaches twice as far.

h_glutton.name: The Glutton
h_glutton.up: Each Devour grows an extra mutation you have learned but aren't wearing, for 10 s.
h_glutton.rev: Ranged: Devour doesn't feed you. You vomit what you ate as a cone of blood and gore at the cursor.

h_heart.name: The Bleeding Heart
h_heart.up: Above 80% Vitae, your skills cost no life at all.
h_heart.rev: Your skills take no Vitae, only raw life, and Vitae becomes a shield that soaks 70% of every blow.

f_gnash.name: Gnashing Maw
f_gnash.up: Belly Maw blows also bite a second enemy next to the first.

f_shed.name: Shed Scar
f_shed.up: When you are struck, Scar-Plates may tear loose a ridge of scar that cuts the attacker.

f_quick.name: Quick Meal
f_quick.up: Devour takes no time and gives 50% more Vitae.

f_gills.name: Deep Gills
f_gills.up: Blood Gills work up to 1 yd from a pool.

f_coil.name: Coiling Tentacles
f_coil.up: Tentacles hold what they catch for 1 s.

hk_marrow.name: The Marrow-Kin
hk_marrow.up: Spawnlings grow bone plates: they take 30% less damage and burst into bone shards when they die.

hk_hunger.name: The Hungering Aether
hk_hunger.up: Your kills leave soul wisps that drift to you and refill 3% Vitae each.

a_anvil.name: The Anvil
a_anvil.up: The Iron Golem's blows leave splinters of mirror-glass on the ground that cut enemies walking through it.
a_anvil.rev: Melee: you wear the golem as a shell of polished iron. It soaks half of every blow, and your weapon strikes like the golem's loadout (sword, axe or flail).

a_maiden.name: The Maiden's Kiss
a_maiden.up: The Hall of Mirrors also drags enemies within 3 yd into the cage.
a_maiden.rev: The Hall of Mirrors closes on you instead: while it lasts, melee attackers take 60% of their blow back, but you move 20% slower.

a_storm.name: Storm
a_storm.up: Standing mirrors call lightning down on the nearest enemy every second.
a_storm.rev: Shield Toss arcs lightning between everything it hits.

i_quake.name: Aftershock
i_quake.up: Rising mirrors stun twice as long.

i_rust.name: Tarnish
i_rust.up: Enemies next to your mirrors take 15% more damage.

i_rally.name: Rally
i_rally.up: When the golem rises from dormancy it mends 15% of your life.

i_spikes.name: Standing Shards
i_spikes.up: Mirror Fissure leaves one more mirror standing.

a_choir.name: The Choir
a_choir.up: Every 2 s your whole choir strikes together: revenants dive at one target and darting wisps loose at once.
a_choir.rev: A revenant wisp that strikes an enemy dives into it and possesses it for 3 s. The possessed fights for you.

a_bell.name: The Bell-Warden
a_bell.up: Every fifth spell rings a bell that stuns enemies within 3.5 yd for 0.5 s.
a_bell.rev: Enemies within 5 yd can't cast or shoot, and neither can you for 1 s after each spell.

a_lantern.name: The Lantern-Bearer
a_lantern.up: Your Soul Lantern follows you instead of staying planted.
a_lantern.rev: Melee: you swing the lantern as a flail. Each blow splashes around the target, and every other blow frees a wisp.

w_ember.name: Long Flight
w_ember.up: Darting and splitting wisps ricochet once more before they fly home.

w_host.name: Great Host
w_host.up: The great wisp can hold 3 more wisps.

w_tether.name: Silver Tether
w_tether.up: Leashing the golem heals it twice as fast and speeds it up more.

w_wake.name: Wake
w_wake.up: A revenant wisp that perishes mends 2% of your life.

a_sage.name: The Aether-Sage
a_sage.up: Chain: Soul Swarm, Spirit Dart and Aether Orb jump to 2 more enemies at 60%.
a_sage.rev: Nothing chains. Soul Swarm becomes a tether that drains its target's life into yours for 3 s, and Spirit Dart and Aether Orb heal you for 20% of their damage.

a_blade.name: The Hollow Blade
a_blade.up: Spirit Dart leaps to 2 more enemies and leaves ghost trails that burn.
a_blade.rev: Melee: Spirit Dart becomes a spirit sword. Hold to swing it in wide arcs.

a_pyre.name: Pyre
a_pyre.up: Soul Storm souls and Aether Orb shards set enemies on fire.
a_pyre.rev: Wraith Form leaves a trail of spirit fire behind you.

a_rebuke.name: The Rebuke
a_rebuke.up: Soul Leash cracks like a whip every second: everything touching the rope is struck and thrown back.
a_rebuke.rev: Ranged: Soul Leash fires as a harpoon. It strikes hard and pins its target in place.

g_ward.name: Deep Ward
g_ward.up: Spirit Ward soaks 5% more of every blow.

g_mark.name: Branding Mark
g_mark.up: Mark of Logos lasts twice as long.

g_orb.name: Heavy Orb
g_orb.up: Aether Orb flies slower and lives 50% longer.

g_swarm.name: Soul Hunger
g_swarm.up: Souls strike one more time before they fade.

a_revenant.name: The Revenant
a_revenant.up: A revenant wisp that perishes returns as a bone-armored spirit for 5 s.

a_hunger.name: The Hungering Aether
a_hunger.up: Soul Swarm souls steal a little life with every hit.

z_bloom.name: The Bloom
z_bloom.up: Miasma Nova leaves a ring of miasma clouds where it ends, even without Lingering Ring, and its clouds last longer.
z_bloom.rev: Ranged: Miasma Nova erupts at the cursor instead of around you.

z_tide.name: The Tide
z_tide.up: Miasma Tide splits into three walls in a fan.
z_tide.rev: Melee: Miasma Tide whirls around you as a ring of cutting miasma for 2 s instead of rolling forward.

z_venom.name: The Serpent
z_venom.up: Venom Blade miasma stacks up to five times, and each stack slows harder.
z_venom.rev: Ranged: while Venom Blade lasts, your weapon attacks throw three venom knives instead of cutting.

z_plague.name: The Plague-Bearer
z_plague.up: You leave a trail of miasma clouds wherever you walk.
z_plague.rev: Your cloud drinks instead of sickening: every enemy in it feeds you a little of its life.

zm_fang.name: Barbed Knives
zm_fang.up: Venom knives and needles pass through one more enemy.

zm_breath.name: Held Breath
zm_breath.up: Exhale keeps a quarter of the Miasma it spends, and Inhale draws in clouds from twice as far.

zm_carrion.name: Carrion Flowers
zm_carrion.up: Sickened enemies that die leave a cloud 15% more often.

zm_contag.name: Wider Contagion
zm_contag.up: Contagion leaps to one more enemy each time.

z_mirror.name: The Mirror
z_mirror.up: Blur leaves two decoys instead of one.
z_mirror.rev: Melee: Blur steps into the enemy nearest the cursor and strikes it, gaining an Omen. The decoy stays where you stood.

z_hanged.name: The Hanged Man
z_hanged.up: Enemies that wander into Haze hang in the air: held for 1.5 s before the madness takes them.
z_hanged.rev: Haze becomes a mantle on you for 6 s: anything that comes close is confused.

z_trapq.name: The Trapper-Queen
z_trapq.up: Traps arm the moment they land, and you can have two more out.
z_trapq.rev: Traps are worn, not thrown. Each time you are struck, a worn trap springs at your feet.

zd_needle.name: Twin Needles
zd_needle.up: Needle Sentries fire two needles at a time.

zd_snare.name: Heavy Smoke
zd_snare.up: Miasma Wake smokes 50% longer and its waves hit a quarter harder.

zd_mine.name: Chain Spores
zd_mine.up: Bloat Mine bursts a second time.

zd_lure.name: Siren Song
zd_lure.up: Siren Lure confuses what it drags.

zd_mirage.name: Warped Flesh
zd_mirage.up: Enemies in Mirage take 15% more damage.

z_reaper.name: The Reaper
z_reaper.up: A finisher that kills keeps its Omens.
z_reaper.rev: Ranged: Reap is thrown. A spectral scythe flies out and back, spending your Omens on everything it cuts.

z_grave.name: The Grave
z_grave.up: Grave Strike, Carrion Talon and Reap root what they hit for a second.
z_grave.rev: Your cloud turns to grave-dust: it stops sickening, but everything in it is slowed hard and takes 15% more damage.

z_death.name: Death
z_death.up: Every kill, by any means, gives an Omen.
z_death.rev: Omens never fade, but you can hold only two, and finishers strike for double.

zx_step.name: Death's Wake
zx_step.up: Death's Step leaves miasma clouds along its path.

zx_kiss.name: Iron Heel
zx_kiss.up: Carrion Talon kicks one more time.

zx_knell.name: Long Knell
zx_knell.up: The Mourning Knell terrifies for 1 s longer.

zx_breath.name: Grave Breath
zx_breath.up: Last Breath holds you twice in each place.

z_veiled.name: The Veiled Mother
z_veiled.up: Your cloud and your miasma clouds cloud minds: enemies in them are now and then confused.

z_widow.name: The Black Widow
z_widow.up: Kills made by a finisher spin a web of miasma: every enemy within 2.5 yd is held fast for 1.5 s.

h_step.name: Hollow Step
h_step.up: Dodge rolls leave a silent afterimage. Enemies within 3 yd are staggered for 0.5 s.

h_quiet.name: Unheard
h_quiet.up: Enemies notice you at 70% of the usual range.

v_unwritten.name: The Unwritten
v_unwritten.up: Your kills leave no corpse and drop nothing, but each one refills 5% of your Essence.
v_unwritten.rev: You leave no trace: an enemy that can't see you for 2 s loses you.

v_crown.name: The Choir Crown
v_crown.up: While you are above half life, every wisp you spend or lose comes back to the choir 3 s later. Each wisp in your choir drains 0.3% of your life per second.
v_crown.rev: Potions don't heal you. Each wisp in your choir mends 0.3% of your life per second instead.

v_silence.name: The Last Silence
v_silence.up: Once per zone, a killing blow stops time for 3 s and leaves you at 1 life.
v_silence.rev: Your skills make no light: enemies notice you at half range.

v_unmade.name: The Unmade
v_unmade.up: One Major you hold counts upright and reversed at once (choose it in the web). You lose 25% of your maximum life.
v_unmade.rev: +1 to all your skills for each Major you hold (up to +4). You lose 25% of your maximum life.

kr_noon.name: The Noon That Falls
kr_noon.up: Fist-Of-High-Noon does not fall alone: two lesser fists follow on the nearest enemies around the first, at half strength.
kr_noon.rev: Melee: the fist is your own. Fist-Of-High-Noon comes down from your hand on the enemy in reach, at once and 60% harder.

kr_star.name: The Morning Star
kr_star.up: The breath sweeps back the way it came: a second pass of Morning-Star-Exhaled follows the first, at 60%.
kr_star.rev: The breath is drawn in, not out: Morning-Star-Exhaled drags what it burns 2 yd toward you and blinds it for half a second, but burns 30% less.

kr_sutra.name: The Burning Sutra
kr_sutra.up: Each talisman of Sutra-That-Seeks leaves a burning seal where it bursts, searing what stands on it for 3 s.
kr_sutra.rev: The halo is worn, not loosed: while Sutra-That-Seeks holds talismans, a blow struck on you in melee burns one away, and it bursts on the one who struck for double.

kr_ash.name: Ash in the Palms
kr_ash.up: When Hundred-Hands-Of-Morning ends, the ground where its target stood burns for 4 s.

kr_tears.name: Tears Without End
kr_tears.up: Tears-For-The-Living lets fall two more tears.

kr_brush.name: The Quick Brush
kr_brush.up: The halo of Sutra-That-Seeks regrows 30% faster.

kr_wax.name: Cooling Wax
kr_wax.up: Amber-That-Eats-Itself eats a third less of your life.

ka_spade.name: The Gravedigger
ka_spade.up: A shadow torn loose by Spade-That-Cuts-Shadows crawls to the nearest other enemy within 3 yd and pins it too.
ka_spade.rev: Ranged: the spade flings its cut as a black crescent. Spade-That-Cuts-Shadows flies 7 yd through everything, tearing the shadows of all it crosses, at 80%.

ka_palm.name: The Hungry Ghost
ka_palm.up: Palm-That-Is-Hungry eats what it gathers: an enemy dragged to your feet with less than 15% of its life is swallowed whole (not uniques or bosses).
ka_palm.rev: The palm casts out instead of drawing in: Palm-That-Is-Hungry throws everything in its reach out to the edge, stunned for 1 s, tearing at it as it goes.

ka_clap.name: The Unstruck Bell
ka_clap.up: The clap is answered: a second, wider ring of Clap-That-Ends-Speech follows 0.4 s later, at 60%.
ka_clap.rev: Clap-That-Ends-Speech makes no sound. It stuns nothing, but it unmakes every enemy missile within 6 yd, and what stands in the ring cannot strike for 4 s.

ka_bowl.name: Alms of Nothing
ka_bowl.up: Drinking from the Bowl-That-Holds-Nothing also runs 3% of the sand out of both bulbs for each thing it held.

ka_roots.name: The Starved Take Root
ka_roots.up: The roots of Spit-For-The-Starving stay 1 s longer.

ka_grip.name: Cold Fingers Below
ka_grip.up: Hand-From-Below holds its prey 1 s longer (bosses excepted).

ka_pitch.name: Pitch on the Soles
ka_pitch.up: Walks-Without-Feet pours a third less sand into the glass.

kd_finger.name: The Koan
kd_finger.up: The answer hardens: an enemy One-Finger-Truth strikes and does not kill turns to weeping stone for 2 s, and your next blow shatters it.
kd_finger.rev: Ranged: the finger points and does not touch. One-Finger-Truth strikes the first enemy in a 7 yd line, through armour, at 80%.

kd_mount.name: The Laughing Mountain
kd_mount.up: The mountain lands twice: after Mountain-Falls-Laughing you bounce 2 yd onward and fall again, at 60%.
kd_mount.rev: Mountain-Falls-Laughing does not leap: you drop where you stand, and the stone rolls out twice as far and stuns what it strikes.

kd_arms.name: The Thousand-Armed
kd_arms.up: The arms of Thousand-Arms-Of-Nothing strike all the way round you, not only in a cone.
kd_arms.rev: The arms of Thousand-Arms-Of-Nothing do not strike out. For 6 s they close around you as a shell: blows on you lose 40%, and an arm strikes back at whoever struck you in melee.

kd_bedrock.name: Bedrock Wakes Far
kd_bedrock.up: Step-That-Wakes-Bedrock raises four more spears at the end of its line.

kd_stone.name: Stone Patience
kd_stone.up: Grip-Of-Old-Stone holds its stone 1 s longer (bosses excepted).

kd_door.name: The Unmoving Door
kd_door.up: Once you have stood still for a second, blows on you lose 10%.

kh_lantern.name: The Black-Flame Lantern
kh_lantern.up: While you hold the sky (Halo-That-Turns or Gate-Without-A-Gate), each kill holds it 1 s longer, up to 10 s more.

kh_unraised.name: The Unraised
kh_unraised.up: What the Ossuary raises cannot stand before you: the raised dead take 20% more from you, and one that falls bursts into bone-dust that stuns those beside it for half a second.
